subject.title: Santa Clara Valley Water District Board, District 7

text: I'm Pete Dailey, candidate for the Santa Clara Valley Water District. I moved to Silicon Valley in 1993, and have lived or worked in Los Gatos, Mountain View, Palo Alto, and Los Altos, where I recently served as Mayor, and continue to serve on the City Council. I have an undergraduate degree from Berkeley, and master's degrees from Pepperdine and Stanford.

In addition to balancing the city's budget after years of deficits, lowering crime and improving public safety, I also delivered on promises to build housing and improve environmental sustainability. I built this success on teamwork. Los Altos even earned the State of California's Prohousing designation while I was Mayor.

I have served on the Valley Water Commission for four years and was elected Chair in 2025. I am committed to the agency's complex three-part mission to protect our vital water supply, prevent flooding, and steward the habitat in our watershed.
I'm running to deliver on this mission for the residents of the district, who deserve to be represented by a Director known for teamwork, collegiality, professionalism, and ethical public service.
For more information, go to www.pete4water.com. Vote Pete Dailey for a more effective board.

text: Incumbent, Water District Director, Attorney & Environmentalist

Stanford, Harvard Law
It is an honor serving you on the Valley Water Board. I take your trust seriously and am proud to have fulfilled the promises I made when I last sought your vote.

You asked me to eliminate irresponsible projects that would raise water rates without sufficient benefits. I partnered with the community, nonprofits, and property owners, and ended the troubled Pacheco Dam project, saving billions of dollars.
You asked me to deliver accountability from District leadership. I worked with staff and the community to ensure that two six-figure executives accused of wrongdoing no longer serve the District.
You asked me to protect your tax dollars. I preserved funding for critical flood-control projects to keep our homes and communities safe.
Throughout my term, as circumstances shifted, I did not waver. I stood up for you, fought for you, and involved you in decisions about you.

The Water District is entering a new chapter. As your experienced, independent, and hard-working Director, I will deliver responsible, local and lower-cost solutions including water capture and recycling.

With your vote, I will continue to bring competence, transparency, and highest integrity to Valley Water to ensure affordable clean water today and in the future.
Gratefully,
www.rebecca4water.com
